items.title: 5.10 Increase in flow velocity (flow velocity ka barhna) (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Rubber ke pipe ko daba kar hum us mein pani ki flow velocity barha sakte hain. Pipe dabane se woh cross-sectional area kam ho jata hai jis se pani guzarta hai. Equation of continuity ke mutabiq:

Yahan A cross-sectional area aur v flow velocity hai. Jab area kam ho (A₂ < A₁) to flow rate (Av) wahi rakhne ke liye pani ki velocity v₂ ko barhna parta hai. Is liye rubber pipe dabane se pani tez nikalta hai.

blocks.prompt: Garden (bagh) ke hose ka munh daba kar us ka area chautha hissa (¼) kar diya jaye to pani ki speed aur har second nikalne wale volume ka kya hoga?
blocks.explanation: A₁v₁ = A₂v₂ se, area ¼ hone par speed 4 guna ho jati hai. Har second nikalne wala volume (Av) wahi rehta hai (patle munh ki thori extra rukawat ko ignore kar ke).

items: Rubber pipe dabane se A kam hota hai; A₁v₁ = A₂v₂ ke mutabiq pani ki velocity barhti hai; flow rate wahi rehta hai.
